in_text_mentions: ampos Dental School—UNESP) looking for dental treatment. The clinical exam showed completely edentulous and presented a hyperplastic lesion over the alveolar ridge extending to the vestibular sulcus in the lower anterior region (Figures 1 and 2). According to the patient, two previous surgeries were performed to remove the excess of mucosa, but it relapsed twice. This lesion could impair the retention and stability of a future prosthesis. Considering this clinical situation and the relapse history, the immediate confection of dentures and surgical removal with CO2 laser radiation was proposed.
